```{r PRIME scores}
# PRIME Screen
# https://doi.org/10.1016/j.schres.2008.08.018 - Kobayashi et al. (2008)
# https://doi.org/10.1093/schbul/sbae224 Calkins et al (2025)
# Scoring instructions: Sum of the 12 items. Clinical significance is determined by the following criteria:
  # ≥1 item rated 6 (definitely agree)
  # ≥3 items rated 5 (somewhat agree)
  # total items 1-12 ≥ 2 SD away from mean by age (see Table 1 in Calkins et al.).

# Load required packages 
library(dplyr)
library (readr)

# Load data
PRIME <- read_tsv("/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/separate_tsvs/prime.tsv")


# Compute total scores for each individual participant
PRIME <- PRIME %>%
  mutate(
    prime_total_score    = rowSums(select(., prime_1, prime_2, prime_3, prime_4, prime_5, prime_6, prime_7, prime_8, prime_9, prime_10, prime_11, prime_12), na.rm = FALSE),
  )%>%
  rename_with(tolower)

write_tsv(PRIME,"/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/final_scored_tsvs/prime.tsv", na = "n/a")

```

``` {r PRIME distribution}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

PRIME %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = prime_total_score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "PRIME total score (sum of 12 items)", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of PRIME total scores")

```

Compare distribution of 8-10 year olds to 11+ year olds to see if we can use the same clinical significance cut-off.

``` {r age data}
# Load in age data (from previous demographics code):
age_data <- read.csv('/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_code/EF_self_report/EF_age_info.csv')
age_data$participant_id <- paste0("sub-", age_data$participant_id) #add sub- prefix
age_data$session_id     <- paste0("ses-", age_data$session_id) #add ses- prefix

# Left join age data into PRIME
PRIME <- PRIME %>%
  left_join(age_data %>% select(participant_id, session_id, age),
            by = c("participant_id", "session_id")) %>%
  relocate(age, .after = session_id)  # puts age as 3rd column

```

``` {r plot aged distributions}
# split PRIME into two data frames
PRIME_lt11 <- PRIME %>% filter(age < 11)
PRIME_ge11 <- PRIME %>% filter(age >= 11)
PRIME_11 <- PRIME %>% filter(age >= 11 & age < 12)

PRIME_lt11 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = prime_total_score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "PRIME total score", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of PRIME total scores, age <11")

PRIME_ge11 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = prime_total_score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "PRIME total score", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of PRIME total scores, age >= 11")

PRIME_11 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = prime_total_score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "PRIME total score", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of PRIME total scores, age = 11")



PRIME_lt11 %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(prime_total_score)),
    mean_prime_total_score = mean(prime_total_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_prime_total_score = sd(prime_total_score, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  print()

PRIME_11 %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(prime_total_score)),
    mean_prime_total_score = mean(prime_total_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_prime_total_score = sd(prime_total_score, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  print()
```
The distributions do not look similar. Hence, we will make the clinical significance column for 8-10 year olds 'n/a', since it is not comparable to the distribution for 11+ year-olds.

``` {r clinical significance cut-offs}
# Create a vector from Calkins et al. 2025 Table 1 with cut-off scores. ≥ 2 SD away from mean by age indicates clinically significant psychosis spectrum symptoms.

library(tibble)

prime_12_gt2sd <- tibble(
  age = 11:21,
  `>2SD` = c(36, 34, 32, 29, 28, 27, 27, 28, 23, 26, 23)
)
prime_12_gt2sd
```
``` {r clinically significant psychosis spectrum symptoms}
# Clinical significance is met if any of the following criteria are met:
  # - ≥1 item rated 6 (definitely agree)
  # - ≥3 items rated 5 (somewhat agree)
  # - total items 1-12 ≥ 2 SD away from mean by age (see Table 1 Calkins et al. 2025)
# Note that since we don't have comparison data to use as a >=2 SD cut-off for ages 10 and below, their clinical significance score is n/a.

library(dplyr)

prime_12_gt2sd <- tibble::tibble(
  age = 11:21,
  `>2SD` = c(36, 34, 32, 29, 28, 27, 27, 28, 23, 26, 23)
)

prime_items <- paste0("prime_", 1:12)

PRIME <- PRIME %>%
  mutate(
    age_for_cutoff = ifelse(age >= 8 & age <= 11, 11L, as.integer(age))
  ) %>%
  left_join(prime_12_gt2sd, by = c("age_for_cutoff" = "age")) %>%
  mutate(
    n_ge6 = rowSums(across(all_of(prime_items), ~ .x >= 6), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ge5 = rowSums(across(all_of(prime_items), ~ .x >= 5), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    clinically_significant_psychosis_spectrum_symptoms = if_else(
      age < 11,
      NA_integer_,
      as.integer(
        (n_ge6 >= 1) |
        (n_ge5 >= 3) |
        (!is.na(`>2SD`) & prime_total_score >= `>2SD`)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-age_for_cutoff, -`>2SD`, -n_ge6, -n_ge5, -age)

write_tsv(PRIME,"/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/final_scored_tsvs/prime.tsv", na = "n/a")

```
